constraints.name: movement_directions_orthogonal
constraints.description: Only horizontal and vertical steps are allowed, each step moving one unit.

constraints.name: no_point_revisiting
constraints.description: Cannot visit any point more than once along the path.

constraints.name: exact_manhattan_distance_steps
constraints.description: The total number of steps must be exactly the Manhattan distance between start and end points, i.e., abs(a-c)+abs(b-d).
